signin.title: Add an account
signin.name: Name shown (optional)
signin.hint.app: This provider asks for an app password, created in its security settings. Your normal password does not work.
signin.hint.custom: Provider not recognized: type the servers of your mail.
signin.hint.oauth: %s signs in with a code on another device. This is not available in this version yet.
signin.invalid: Check the address: it needs a name, an @ and a domain.
signin.noservers: Type the IMAP and SMTP servers.
signin.oauth.setup: Signing in to Outlook.com needs an app registered at Microsoft (Entra ID, public client). Put its client id in %s as {"microsoft": "<client id>"} and open the app again.
signin.oauth.hint: You will get a code to type on another device (a phone or a computer): no password is typed here.
signin.oauth.steps:
On another device open
%s
and type this code:
signin.oauth.pending: Not approved yet. Finish on the other device and tap again.
signin.oauth.denied: The sign-in was denied on the other device.
signin.oauth.expired: The code expired. Cancel and start again.
signin.oauth.notoauth: This address does not sign in with Microsoft.
